browser-only js target registers no node tasks()
configures declared modules and reuses the configuration cache()
compose jvm and kmp modules apply compiler and multiplatform plugins()
module scripts override the configured jvm target()
local conventions support isolated projects and reuse the configuration cache()
android app library and kmp configure and compile with native compose compiler only()
settings honor host project directory mappings()
